quest.title: The Recollector's Path
quest.description: After speaking of Mihir and the Oceanids, Sorush seemed to be at a loss. Zurvan's training has now progressed beyond its midpoint...\n
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x10, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Zurvan
dialogues.text: Without knowing, the training has progressed to its latter half. How are things going?

choices.text: You can say we're hitting our stride.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Though when Sorush tells us stories, there really seems to be some self-reflection happening...

response.speaker: Zurvan
response.text: Dialogue is a good way for Sorush to learn, especially as the people she's talking to are more interesting than those of the Order of Skeptics.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: #Elder, you are being arbitrary... {NICKNAME} is a remarkable Yasnapati, but not all of the Order of Skeptics's members are...

response.speaker: Zurvan
response.text: Perhaps they do have momentary instances of virtue between sessions of flattery and deception.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Ugh...

response.speaker: Zurvan
response.text: #I see you still need convincing. We will let our witnesses, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, give a review regarding your performance. Of course, that is after you finish your recounting.

choices.text: There's still some room for improvement.

talks.objective: Head to the specified location and complete the trial
Head to the specified location and complete the trial

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so quiet. No one's here.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Even if Rashnu was here, it should still be quite quiet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, but if she was here, we would need to talk softer. She always has that sleepy look on her face, and she didn't seem too happy when we woke her using the Kory Drums.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon heard that the quieter someone is, the worse it gets when they get angry. Who knows what Rashnu is like when she's enraged...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Then, should that be true, my Yasnapati is the one we should fear the most, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? Oh, Paimon knows {M#him}{F#her} the best. Though {NICKNAME} isn't one for talking, {M#he}{F#she} is still super nice. Right?

choices.text: I am about to get mad for real. Rawr.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See. Not scary at all.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Very well. Let us refocus.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: As you behold, this tree is called Barsom, and Rashnu is its familiar, though she is absent right now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And?

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: And? And nothing. There's nothing more to say of Rashnu and the Barsom.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Feels like you are hiding something... Right, about the Kory Drums...

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: H—Hiding? Absurd. As for the drums... Haven't you already seen them in use?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, Paimon remembers Rashnu saying that she's the one who threw the Kory Drums elsewhere. That really surprised Nasejuna.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon recalls, you were really nervous then, and didn't respond to Nasejuna's questioning.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The way it looks now, the Order of Skeptics's archives were reaaallly off the mark.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Though playing the drums did wake Rashnu.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon seems to understand why Zurvan doesn't trust the current Order of Skeptics. Think, Sorush. Did they really help? The clues they gave are half-truths at best...

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Umm...

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: The current generation of the Order of Skeptics indeed does have some lacking members, but like a tree, no matter how many leaves flourish, there will always be some that will shrivel and dry.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Once these dry leaves break and scatter, those that will remain... They will be the ones that can be relied upon... Yes.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: ...How did the Order of Skeptics become like this?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I also want to know that.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: It is because I have been with the Order of Skeptics too long that I grew unable to discern their gradual changes...

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Only when I began to speak with you and other outsiders did I realize the Order of Skeptics had changed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It has been a few hundred years. Besides their name being the same, they must've cycled through a few generations of different members already.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Will the fame I seek, the fame I wish for the Yasnapati to eulogize for me, also erode into this... with everything changed, carrying only a hollow title for others to recall?

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Is that what my elder wishes that I learn? No, it shouldn't be... But...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Sorush, there's no need to be down! Maybe... Maybe Zurvan didn't mean that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seeing Sorush so depressed makes Paimon feel like she did something wrong... Maybe we should have Zurvan cheer her up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #...Okay, {NICKNAME}, you gotta say something! The silence IS actually making Paimon nervous...
